scope: Actual encrypted local development backup; independent disposable runtime on same host, not off-host

logs.filter: Canonical allowlisted fields; collected_at <= acquisition start

metrics.encoding: gzip JSON original samples, eight native six-hour range vectors

offsets.scope: Read-only online SQLite backups, no raw log/chunk payload
